news.title: Plant-inspired natural coatings can beat forever chemicals
news.summary_en: WashU McKelvey Engineering researchers have developed a PFAS alternative that serves as an effective waterproof coating. It makes use of plant waste and can provide waterproof seals without the toxic downstream effects of PFAS on human health and the environment.

news.title: Addressing the youth mental health crisis
news.summary_en: Child and adolescent psychiatrist Cynthia Rogers discusses how WashU Medicine’s clinical expertise, research and expanded access to care are improving the lives of children and their families.

news.title: To restore attention, reach out to nature
news.summary_en: Psychology researchers at WashU have found evidence that children’s exposure to natural spaces correlates with improved attention and achievement scores.
